```scala
package examples.dsl

import scala.language.implicitConversions

import menger.dsl._

/**
 * A single glass sphere hovering above a white floor, lit from above so the sphere
 * focuses light through its curved surface and casts a caustic pattern onto the floor.
 * Caustics are photon-mapped; the glass sphere's curvature is what concentrates the light
 * into the bright caustic below it.
 */
object GlassSphereCaustics:
  val scene = Scene(
    camera = Camera(
      position = (0f, 1.5f, 6f),
      lookAt = (0f, 0f, 0f),
      up = (0f, 1f, 0f)
    ),
    objects = List(
      Sphere(
        pos = (0f, 0f, 0f),
        material = Some(Material.Glass),
        size = 1.0f
      )
    ),
    lights = List(
      Point(position = (0f, 10f, 0f), intensity = 150.0f)
    ),
    planes = List(
      Plane(Y at -2, color = Color.White)
    ),
    background = Some(Color.Black),
    caustics = Some(Caustics.HighQuality),
    render = Some(RenderSettings(transparentShadows = true))
  )

  SceneRegistry.register("glass-sphere-caustics", scene)
```

unit-size glass sphere at the origin above a white floor plane, point light directly overhead, camera 6.2 units out at eye level looking at the origin, high-quality caustics and transparent shadows enabled.
